definitions.explanation: A marine cephalopod with ten arms, two of which are longer tentacles. Squid is a popular food in Japan.

examples.japanese: {居酒屋|いざかや}で{烏賊|いか}の{刺身|さしみ}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered squid sashimi at the izakaya.

examples.japanese: {烏賊|いか}はスミを{吐|は}いて{敵|てき}から{逃|に}げる。
examples.english: Squid squirt ink to escape from enemies.

examples.japanese: {夏祭|なつまつ}りで{烏賊焼|いかや}きを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate grilled squid at the summer festival.

notes:
{烏賊|いか} refers to squid. The kanji literally means "crow thief" (from an old legend).

Alternative writing: イカ (katakana, very common)

Common dishes:
- {烏賊|いか}の{刺身|さしみ} (squid sashimi)
- {烏賊焼|いかや}き (grilled squid)
- {烏賊|いか}そうめん (squid cut into thin noodle-like strips)
- {烏賊|いか}フライ (fried squid)
- {烏賊|いか}{墨|すみ}パスタ (squid ink pasta)

Counter: {杯|はい} (whole squid) or {匹|ひき}

Note:
{烏賊|いか} is distinct from {蛸|たこ} (octopus). Squid have 10 arms while octopuses have 8. The expression {烏賊|いか}{墨|すみ} (squid ink) is used in cooking.
